title: The Piri Reis Map Mystery
hook: Why does a 16th-century map show continents that weren't charted today?
headline: A Map That Defies History

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Ottoman admiral Piri Reis commissioned a world map in March 1513.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The 1513 map shows Brazil's coast, years after Cabral's 1500 landing.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A fragment of the map depicts a southern land, but it does not show ice-covered Antarctica.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: 2020 researchers claim the map copies lost Ptolemaic charts, source still unknown.

end.line: What hidden source could explain this enigmatic map?

description: Explore the puzzling details of the 1513 Piri Reis map and its mysterious origins.
